supervision: additional independent NR3D and official3D instance labels; no benchmark targets

model: unchanged local ReferentGrounder,560897 declared parameters; frozen teachers/native coordinates

benchmark_queries: all original queries and evaluation rules unchanged
reverse_weighting: same target mass as forward loss, not independent normalization of tiny-quality columns

second_round: Same-class query packing versus random packing; forward and bidirectional matched pair, all examples and optimizer budgets retained. Class/instance IDs used only for training sampling.

algebraic_correction.reason: Residual decomposition found22-28 percent query-only offsets in raw bidirectional heads. Those offsets change reverse loss but cannot change a single-query regional ranking.
algebraic_correction.objective: reverse logsoftmax over query-normalized regional log probabilities; no new coefficient
algebraic_correction.schedule: one fixed12-epoch local fit; same named data and random batches as named_bidirectional
algebraic_correction.gate: Use selected calibration checkpoint. Before any new benchmark run require development actual IoU >= named_forward and original correction IoU at least0.5pp above query-mean intervention.
